genius_advantages.point: **SEC cease-and-desist (Jan 14, 2025):** Presto made "materially false and misleading statements" about Presto Voice; "the vast majority of drive-thru orders placed through this version of Presto Voice required human intervention" (Nov 2021–May 2023). No civil penalty, citing cooperation
CKE (a past Presto customer) signed Genius as its exclusive POS with "end-to-end drive-thru technology" (May 2026); Presto's status at CKE after that is not found

competitor_advantages.point: Joined the Toast partner ecosystem Sep 21, 2026, so voice orders now flow into Toast POS/KDS — "we're committed to integration partners who can help customers build the tech stacks they need" (Justin Graham, VP, Toast)
Past CKE upsell results: "significant rise in revenue due to the upsell capability" (Phil Crawford, CKE CTO, 2023)
